notes: High overlap (9/10 claims shared, Jaccard=0.9). LLM finds non-autonomous competition evidence sufficient; peer reviewers find it 'intriguing' but 'underdeveloped' and request mechanistic validation (DILP/nutrient measurements in hemolymph). Disagreement centers on sufficiency of current evidence for mechanism.

High overlap (10/12 claims shared, Jaccard=0.833). Both accept Slimfast dependence findings. Peer reviewers implicitly accept these results by building on them to request rescue experiments for wild-type cells. LLM claims C56, C57 not explicitly addressed by peers but consistent with accepted findings.

Moderate overlap (7/11 claims shared, Jaccard=0.636). LLM finds competition for growth factors/nutrients supported; peer reviewers request functional rescue tests (DILP boost, Slimfast increase in wild-type cells) indicating evidence is incomplete. Disagreement on whether current genetic data sufficiently establishes the competition model.

Moderate overlap (8/13 claims shared, Jaccard=0.615). LLM finds PKB/TORC1 requirement well-supported; peer reviewers accept necessity but request Tsc1 experiments to establish sufficiency and generalizability beyond PTEN. Disagreement on completeness: LLM satisfied with necessity demonstration, peers require sufficiency proof.

Moderate overlap (10/16 claims shared, Jaccard=0.526). Both accept the core phenomenological finding of hypertrophy-to-hyperplasia switch under nutrient restriction. Peer reviewers describe as 'intriguing' and request mechanistic follow-up but do not question the observations themselves. LLM claims C25-C28, C108-C109 provide additional detail not explicitly evaluated by peers.

Moderate overlap (6/14 claims shared, Jaccard=0.429). Both accept apoptosis findings in PTEN clones and enhancement of overgrowth when apoptosis is blocked. These observations are not challenged by reviewers. LLM includes additional claims about cell competition mechanisms (C36-C40, C89, C110) not explicitly addressed by peers.

Low overlap (2/9 claims shared, Jaccard=0.143). Only C71-C72 overlap regarding relative growth differences. LLM finds Tsc1/PTEN and TOR experiments support relative signaling model; peer reviewers' uncertainty about competition mechanism (R2) indirectly questions this interpretation. Most LLM claims (C66-C70) not directly addressed by peers.
Background claims about PTEN function and PI3K signaling (C1-C8). No corresponding peer review evaluation; these are foundational context claims not subject to peer scrutiny in the review.

Claims about reduced insulin signaling requirement for survival under nutrient restriction (C14-C21). Not explicitly evaluated by peer reviewers as a distinct result group, though related to accepted findings in R4.

Speculative implications about tumor progression and therapeutic targeting (C86, C91, C107). LLM correctly identifies these as uncertain/speculative. Not addressed by peer reviewers as they represent future work rather than current findings.

Contextual claims comparing findings to prior work on starvation resistance in different tissues (C73-C80). Not evaluated by peer reviewers; these are literature comparison claims rather than primary findings subject to review.

Claims about cell-autonomous overgrowth, multi-tissue occurrence, and normal differentiation (C113-C120). Not explicitly evaluated as a distinct group by peer reviewers, though these characterization findings are not challenged.
